newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon recommends Mead, Sony.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Salomon recommends Mead, Sony.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it put Mead Corp and Sony Corp on its large-capitalization stock recommended list.
-- Salomon said in a report that analyst Chip Dillon expects Mead to earn $3.65 a share in 1997 "but peak earnings power is about triple that."
-- Sony's shares "appear low for one of the best brand names in the world," the report said.
-- Analyst Koichiro Chiwata sees "a major recovery going on in various businesses" for Sony.
-- Salomon put Buckeye Cellulose Corp on its small-cap recommended list.
-- Buckeye's shares are low for a paper company with high specialty chemical content, the brokerage said.
-- In New York Stock Exchange trading, Mead rose 1-1/2 to 58-3/8, Sony gained 1/2 to 66-7/8, and Buckeye added 1/8 to 28-3/4.
